name: web_modal_search
description: Search for a specific item inside an open modal by text. Scrolls the match into view and takes a snapshot with refs clustered around the target.

inputs.name: query
inputs.description: Text to search for inside the modal (e.g. 'caramel syrup').

outputs.description: Search result summary plus snapshot refs near the matched element.
Whether a matching element was found in the modal.
The actual text of the matched element.
Actionable elements visible in the snapshot after scrolling to the match.
